text:
maria-cs: Heads-up — NimbusBio dedicated pool bring-up scheduled Tue 09:00 PST. Main asks: final quota, autoscale policy, and a dry-run load test plan. Who owns what?

alex-infra: I can own the reserved pool provisioning and quota assignment. Need final RPS and token estimate.

maria-cs: Thanks Alex. They gave us expected steady-state ~1200 rps and peak bursts to 3500rps for 2–3 mins during batch jobs. Token per request ~350 avg.

jamie-sre: For autoscale, suggest target CPU utilization 68% with scale step +2 nodes, cool-down 60s. Want to run shadow load first.

tanvi-cs: I'll validate the customer-side warmup script and confirm traffic patterns (we saw a lot of short conversations + long embeddings). Will share sample traces.

eng-oncall-bot: Ticket created: CS-7891 NimbusBio dedicated bring-up — /assign alex-infra, jamie-sre, tanvi-cs — schedule 2024-11-12T09:00:00-08:00.

lee-pm: Quick ask: what fallback policy if reserved pool saturates? We need a rollback plan for the cutover.

alex-infra: Fallback = route to smaller-compatible model variant in hosted plane + rate-limit non-essential routes. We'll prepare routing policy rule and test it.

jamie-sre: Load test plan: run three phases
1) prefix-caching validation (5m) at 500rps
2) sustained soak (30m) at 1200rps
3) burst ramp tests up to 4000rps with 3x short spikes
I'll run the test from our k8s runner.

maria-cs: Can you post the exact k6 script/command? I'll run a customer-facing dry-run with NimbusBio in shadow mode.

jamie-sre: k6 command below — will push script to the ticket.

```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m --out json=results.json tests/nimbus_wave.js
# ramp bursts: use stages in the JS to hit 4k peak
```

alex-infra: Node sizing note — use g5x.4 for primary, ensure KV cache warmed. We should pre-warm by replaying 10k recent prefixes.

tanvi-cs: Uploading sample traces now to the ticket. Also capturing prompt buckets for quality regression checks.

lee-pm: I'll coordinate a go/no-go checklist: perf SLOs, error budget, fallback in place, customer success oncall.

maria-cs: Owners: Alex = infra/quota + fallback routes, Jamie = load tests + autoscale tuning, Tanvi = traces + quality checks, Lee = go/no-go. I'll schedule a dry-run 48h before cutover.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: Dry-run 2024-11-10T09:00:00-08:00; Channel ping set to @here.

alex-infra: I'll prepare an infra checklist and post before EOD tomorrow.

jamie-sre: Will push k6 script and baseline results to CS-7891 after first run. Expect ~12% tail-latency at 95th under 1200rps initially.

tanvi-cs: Noted — I'll prepare prompt regression eval harness (small eval set) to run during soak.

maria-cs: Great team. If anything blocks quota assignment (billing or KMS), call me immediately. :thumbsup:

lee-pm: Thanks — tagging legal for KMS checklist separately.

maria-cs: closing loop — will update ticket with owners and tentative schedule.
